rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (looked up by name/ZIP, fetched user and order details) and acted on what appears to be the user’s own order. However, it executed order-changing actions (return and exchanges) via tool calls without any explicit confirmation from the user beforehand, which violates the stated policy requiring confirmation before writes. Additionally, while it computed exchange savings, there’s no clear evidence it provided the savings comparison for both options (return vs. exchange) as requested. Given these issues, it does not meet the pass bar.
